caption: The drawing depicts a single object resembling a transparent or glass oil lamp or vase centered on a plain beige background. The main body of the object is clear, allowing visibility through to the background, with subtle reflections and highlights indicating its reflective surface. The base is wide, stepped, and square, leading up to a fluted pedestal that transitions into a more rounded, bulbous upper section. At the very top, there is a short, cylindrical neck capped with a metallic, possibly brass, collar. Below the object, there is a small linear scale for reference. In the lower right corner, the name "John Dana" and the date "Apr. 13, 1936" are inscribed in small, precise lettering.
title: Lamp
